product_one_liner.value: WindBorne combines data from its long-duration weather-balloon constellation with AI forecasts to provide weather intelligence and decision-support tools for individuals and weather-sensitive businesses and organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The site lists product, API, benchmarks, and FAQ resources but no public pricing page; enterprise solutions direct visitors to contact the company.

named_customers.notes: The company describes NOAA as an operational customer and identifies contracts with the Navy and Air Force.

employee_band.notes: The company data lists an official employee count of 101; another dated listing reports 94 as of July 2026, so the reported figures differ around the band boundary.

hq_location.notes: The company says it is based in Redwood Shores, California.

eng_blog.notes: Both posts discuss product/model development and identify machine-learning engineers as authors.

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation includes getting-started guidance and multiple endpoint/reference articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer posting has an active application link.

model_provider.value: WindBorne’s own WeatherMesh forecasting model (including WeatherMesh-6); no third-party model provider is publicly identified.
